items.name: Wall
items.label: Wall panel (2 × 3 m)
items.place: on a grid line: x or z on a whole odd metre (1, 3, …), 0° or 90°

items.name: WallDoorway
items.label: Wall — open doorway
items.place: like a wall: an open 1.2 × 2.4 m passage with lit jambs

items.name: SlidingDoor
items.label: Sliding door + frame (fits the doorway)
items.place: at the SAME position and rotation as a Wall — open doorway (closes it)

items.name: WallDoor
items.label: Wall + sliding door
items.place: like a wall (the doorway and the door in one piece)

items.name: WallWindow
items.label: Wall + window
items.place: like a wall; the glass sits in a 1.4 × 1.0 m opening, sill at 1 m

items.name: CornerPost
items.label: Corner post
items.place: on a grid point where two walls meet (fills the outer corner)

items.name: Pillar
items.label: Pillar / strut
items.place: on a grid point (a hall column, a corner, a gate post)

items.name: FloorPlate
items.label: Floor plate (2 × 2 m)
items.place: in a 2 × 2 cell: x and z on odd metres

items.name: FloorGrate
items.label: Floor grating (2 × 2 m)
items.place: in a 2 × 2 cell, like a floor plate (the same 0.1 m top)

items.name: CeilingLight
items.label: Ceiling panel + light strip
items.place: in a 2 × 2 cell on the wall tops: y = 3
items.pivotDoc: the slab's bottom centre (the light strip hangs 1.5 cm below it)

items.name: Stairs
items.label: Stairs (1 storey)
items.place: in a 2 × 4 slot, bottom step at +Z; the top step is level with y = 3

items.name: Ramp
items.label: Ramp (2 × 2 m, 1 m rise)

items.name: Railing
items.label: Railing (2 m)
